title: [Decision] Should every last-admin-guard standing write (grant revoke or re-point, membership, organization) also refuse leaving no platform administrator, not only the activation-ledger switch-off?
body:
domain:server#5 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cz2MxDkQYCC4U8indM

Follow-up of #33082 (seat ruling A, option B split out as ADR-level).

## Context

`last-admin-guard.ts` judges every standing write against the `administrators` population: platform administrators **and** organization owners/admins (half 2, `isOrgAdminGrade`). ADR-0135 D5.2 states the invariant as "never left with zero administrators who can sign in", and an organization owner can sign in.

#33082 found the gap that this leaves for the activation ledger: switching `admin_full_access` off was let through on an organization owner's standing, but the only door that switches it back on asks for `manage_metadata`, which `organization_admin_no_bypass` does not carry under `single`. The #33082 fix (option A) adds a second verdict to the **ledger halves only** (`refuseIfPlatformStandingEnds`): refuse when no unbanned platform administrator would remain.

## The open question

The same shape may exist on the other standing halves. For example, revoking (or re-pointing off the Default Organization) the last `admin_full_access` grant while an organization owner remains is permitted today. Whether that owner can grant `admin_full_access` back depends on the delegated-admin gates, and that is not measured here.

Options:

- **A. Keep as is.** Only the ledger halves judge the platform-admin population. The other halves keep the D5.2 "can sign in" population.
- **B. Every standing half also judges the platform-admin population.** This changes what ADR-0135 D5.2 counts as an administrator, so it needs an ADR amendment and a ruling. It is BREAKING for every write that ends the last grant-anchored platform admin while an organization admin remains.
- **C. Measure first.** For each standing half, check whether an organization owner/admin can restore platform-admin standing in-product. Apply B only to the halves where they cannot.

Reader who acts: `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/last-admin-guard.ts` (`enforceStanding`, `refuseIfPlatformStandingEnds`), `docs/adr/0135-identity-and-access-architecture.md` D5.2.

Dedupe: `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue last-admin platform-admins population` → only #33082.
